entries.proposition: FRA16D (the fragile site within WWOX) is identified in the iPSC dataset with 18 breaks, belongs to the Minor cluster and is line-specific to one of the three lines (P1L5); in lymphocytes and fibroblasts it ranks among the most active sites. It does not dominate the iPSC landscape.
entries.snippet: FRA16D (18 breaks) was line-specific to P1L5.

entries.proposition: WWOX is named, with FHIT, MACROD2 and PARK2, among tumour-suppressor genes at fragile-site loci that are not themselves recurrently rearranged in iPSC cultures; the authors say their potential instability warrants attention and is relevant for neural differentiation.
